guides.title: 📖 App Guide
guides.subtitle: Learn how to get the most out of MM2 Values

sections.title: 🔪 Item Values
content: • Values are updated regularly from verified community sources.
• Each item shows its trade value based on demand and rarity.
• "Supreme" values reflect a separate valuation source.
• Tap any item to see full details, demand score, and history.
• Use the search bar to quickly find any weapon, pet, or item.

sections.title: 🔄 Trading
content: • Create trade posts by selecting items you HAVE and items you WANT.
• The calculator shows if a trade is a Win, Fair, or Loss.
• Browse the trading feed to find open trade offers.
• Tap any trade to see details and contact the trader.
• Rate traders after completing trades to build trust.

sections.title: 📋 My Stuff
content: • Track your inventory — add items you own to see your total value.
• Set goals — add items to your wishlist to track what you need.
• Portfolio valuation shows your collection breakdown.
• Active trades and trade history help you track all your deals.

sections.title: 💬 Chat
content: • Public chat rooms let you discuss trades and values.
• Private messages (DMs) are available for 1-on-1 conversations.
• Reply to messages by long-pressing on them.
• Report inappropriate messages using the report button.
• Toggle notifications in settings to control alerts.

sections.title: ⭐ Ratings & Reviews
content: • Rate other traders after completing trades.
• View trader profiles to see their reputation before trading.
• Higher-rated traders are more trustworthy.
• Your rating is visible on your profile and trade posts.

sections.title: 🎮 Games & XP
content: • Play daily games to earn XP and level up.
• Daily Quiz: 5 questions, 12 seconds each — +10 XP per correct answer.
• Spin the wheel daily for bonus XP rewards.
• Claim daily stars for 7 days straight for escalating rewards.
• XP unlocks cosmetics like profile frames and chat colors.

sections.title: 🏆 Badges & Levels
content: • Earn XP by trading, posting, playing games, and logging in daily.
• 14 levels from Rookie 🔪 to Mythic 🌀.
• Certain levels unlock exclusive cosmetics automatically.
• View all your badges and progress in the Badges screen.
• Share your badge card with friends!

sections.title: 👤 Profile
content: • Set your display name and avatar from Settings.
• Link your Roblox username so traders can find you.
• Your profile shows your level, badges, and trade rating.
• Toggle features like online status and country flag display.

sections.title: 🛡️ Safety Tips
content: • Never share your Roblox password or account details.
• Use the in-app calculator to verify trade fairness.
• Report suspicious users or scam attempts immediately.
• Check the scammer database before trading with new users.
• If a deal seems too good to be true, it probably is.

chat_rules.title: Community Chat Rules
rules: Always communicate respectfully. Hate speech, discrimination, and harassment are strictly prohibited.
Avoid sharing offensive, explicit, or inappropriate content, including text, images, or links.
Do not share personal, sensitive, or confidential information such as phone numbers, addresses, or financial details.
Spamming, repetitive messaging, or promoting products/services without permission is not allowed.
If you encounter inappropriate behavior, use the report or block tools available in the app.
Use appropriate language in the chat. Avoid abusive or overly aggressive tones.
Discussions or activities promoting illegal or unethical behavior are prohibited.
Users are responsible for the content they share and must adhere to community guidelines.
Moderators reserve the right to monitor and take action on any violations, including warnings or bans.
Content should be suitable for all approved age groups, adhering to app age requirements.
Do not share links to harmful sites, malware, or malicious content.
By using the chat feature, you agree to the app’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. https://mm2values.app/privacy

groups_guide.create_step_1: Go to the main Chat screen and tap the plus icon (+) in the header.
groups_guide.create_step_2: Select members from the online users list (tap users to select more than one).
groups_guide.create_step_3: Tap the "Create" or "Add" button at the top. It shows "Create" if you don't have a group yet, or "Add" if you already have one.
groups_guide.create_step_4: If you're creating a new group, enter a group name (required, max 50 characters) in the window that appears.
groups_guide.create_step_6: The members you selected will get an invitation to join your group.
groups_guide.feature_members: View group members and their roles.
groups_guide.feature_messages: Send text messages, images and items (up to 18 items per message).
groups_guide.feature_notifications: Get notified about new messages when you're not in the chat.
groups_guide.feature_online: See who's online in your group.
groups_guide.rule_admin_transfer: If an admin (not the creator) makes another member admin, they go back to being a regular member. The creator always stays admin.
groups_guide.rule_group_admin: The creator is the admin. Admins can remove members and make other members admin.
groups_guide.rule_invitations: Members must accept an invitation before they can join.
groups_guide.rule_leaving: Members can leave at any time. If an admin/creator leaves, a new admin is picked at random. If the last member leaves, the group is deleted.
groups_guide.rule_max_members: Each group can have up to 50 members.
groups_guide.rule_min_members: A group must have at least 2 members (including you).
groups_guide.rule_one_group: You can create and be the admin of up to {{max}} groups at a time. There's no limit on how many groups you can join.
groups_guide.title: Groups Guide
